candidates.title: Best Paper Award
candidates.issuer: ECIR (European Conference on Information Retrieval) / BCS-IRSG
candidates.description: For the single-author paper "Sorting Out the Document Identifier Assignment Problem" at the 29th ECIR, awarded while he was a researcher at ISTI-CNR, Pisa.

candidates.title: Test of Time Award
candidates.description: Retrospective award for the 2007 paper "Sorting Out the Document Identifier Assignment Problem"; presented at ECIR 2018 in Grenoble.

candidates.title: Best Paper Award
candidates.description: For the paper "Enhancing XAI Narratives through Multi-Narrative Refinement and Knowledge Distillation" (co-authored with F. Giorgi, M. Silvestri, G. Tolomei), presented at the Human-Centric AI workshop co-located with CIKM 2025 in Seoul.

notes: Both the DIAG Sapienza faculty page (https://www.diag.uniroma1.it/users/fabrizio_silvestri) and the RSTLess lab bio (https://rstless-lab.netlify.app/authors/silvestri/) state that Silvestri holds 'three best paper awards and other international awards'. I could institutionally verify two best paper awards (ECIR 2007 and HCAI@CIKM 2025) plus the ECIR 2018 Test-of-Time Award. The third best paper award is referenced on his LinkedIn 'Honors & Awards' section as a 'Best Paper Award at 2004 IEEE...' (venue cut off in snippet) — human reviewer should chase this lead; I could not corroborate it from an institutional page within my search budget. LinkedIn also lists him as a 'Finalist for the ERCIM Cor Baayen Award' (one of two Italian nominees for 2005); this is a finalist nomination rather than a win and I could not confirm it on an ERCIM page. His personal site (https://fabsilvestri.github.io/) describes him as an 'ELLIS Fellow'; ELLIS Fellow is a formal honor from the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, but I did not locate an ELLIS directory entry to confirm the year, so it is not included above. Search-tool quota was exhausted before I could run additional disambiguation queries. Namesakes filtered out: Simone Silvestri (U. Kentucky, different first name, surfaced in searches), and the Italian journalist/filmmaker Fabrizio Silvestri — neither appeared in the verified sources above.
